Karnataka Cabinet Approves Confiscation of Book Criticizing Basavanna

The Karnataka Cabinet has approved the confiscation of the book "Basava Mantapa," authored by U.S.-based writer Ravi Hanj. The decision follows accusations from the Basava Samiti that the book "insults" the 12th-century social reformer Basavanna and "distorts" his philosophy, thereby hurting the sentiments of his followers. Minister Eshwar Khandre confirmed the Cabinet's approval.
